remarks_1999: John Marin, Jr, mentioned in backing inscription 6, was the son of artist John Marin, and worked for Halpert. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, June 1958." Reproduced and titled *East River New York, N.Y.* in *Art Digest* (1935); *East River from the Shelton* in *Fortune* (1939). Pictured in 1935 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 59, 60. See cat. nos. 520, 521. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A New York cityscape with a bright blue river running through its center. In the foreground is the near bank of the river, with numerous tall buildings in tones of gray and brown. Boats float along the river from the left to right side of the composition. In the background, the far bank of the river is visible, its buildings obscured and softened by atmospheric haze. Stretching above is a thin strip of grayish pink sky. Numerous smokestacks are visible throughout the composition.
title: East River from the 30th Story of the Shelton Hotel
